title: Executive Summary
description: Concise, stakeholder-friendly overview of the project, proposed POC, and expected business outcome.
purpose: Provide decision-makers with a high-level summary of the POC value and direction.

include_when: Always included by default as the lead section in a POC proposal.
exclude_when: Only when producing an abbreviated technical appendix or supplementary note.

instructions: Synthesize the client problem and explain the proposed approach in 2 to 3 paragraphs.
Highlight the primary technical capability being validated.
State the expected business outcome without inventing unverified ROI metrics.

content_structure.purpose: Summarize the business context and the overarching POC goal.
Bullet points highlighting core deliverables and outcomes.

title: Current Challenges & Business Need
description: Details the operational challenges, pain points, and business motivations necessitating the POC.
purpose: Establish the problem baseline that the proposed solution aims to resolve.

include_when: Client has documented pain points, bottlenecks, or legacy constraints.
exclude_when: Purely speculative research projects with no immediate business problem.

instructions: Describe the current operational state and specific bottlenecks.
Distinguish confirmed factual pain points from inferred challenges.
Focus on technical limitations impacting the business.

content_structure.purpose: Key operational and technical pain points.

title: POC Objectives
description: Defines what the Proof of Concept is specifically designed to prove, demonstrate, or de-risk.
purpose: Establish clear goals and validation criteria for the engagement.

include_when: Always included to define bounded validation criteria.

instructions: State clear, measurable objectives grounded in the supplied context.
Do not invent arbitrary numeric targets unless provided by the source.
Distinguish technical viability goals from business feasibility goals.

title: Proposed Solution
description: Explains the proposed approach, capabilities, and key solution concepts.
purpose: Convey the conceptual and functional design addressing the business need.

include_when: Always included as the central technical proposal.

instructions: Explain the solution components and how they directly remediate the identified challenges.
Outline core capabilities in a structured format.
Clearly flag any foundational assumptions.

content_structure.purpose: Structured mapping of capabilities to business value.

title: POC Scope
description: Explicitly demarcates what is included within the POC and what is deferred to subsequent phases.
purpose: Prevent scope creep and align stakeholder expectations on boundaries.

include_when: Always included to delineate project boundaries.

instructions: Clearly separate In-Scope from Out-of-Scope deliverables.
Ensure out-of-scope items prevent misunderstandings around full production readiness.

title: Deliverables & Success Criteria
description: Specifies concrete artifacts produced and the acceptance criteria required to judge the POC successful.
purpose: Define tangible outputs and unambiguous validation benchmarks.

include_when: Always included to define acceptance and handoff requirements.

instructions: Itemize all tangible artifacts (code, documentation, deployed sandbox, report).
Define concrete success criteria grounded in the provided requirements.
Do not invent fabricated percentage thresholds unless supported by context.

content_structure.purpose: Catalogue of deliverables and verification criteria.

title: Conclusion & Next Steps
description: Summarizes the POC proposal and establishes immediate next steps for approval and kickoff.
purpose: Provide a clean, actionable close to the proposal document.

include_when: Standard closing section for POC proposals.

instructions: Reiterate the value and feasibility demonstrated by the proposed plan.
List concrete next steps required to commence engagement.
Do not introduce new technical claims or surprise dependencies.
